purpose: Regression fingerprint for the Puzzle / Worksheet Generators V1 lock. Covers the 4 visible puzzle/worksheet product types: word_search, crossword, math_worksheet, spelling_worksheet.

flask_app/services/word_search/word_list.role: Local topic pack matcher. Whole-token + exact-phrase only. No substring cross-pack supplementation.

flask_app/services/word_search/pdf_build.role: Word Search PDF orchestrator (single-worksheet + book modes).

flask_app/services/crossword/word_entrie.role: Crossword local topic vocabulary (no API) + AI fallback (last resort).

flask_app/services/math_worksheet/builde.role: Math Worksheet problem generator. Fully local / procedural (chat_json removed). include_challenge default False.

flask_app/services/math_worksheet/pdf_bu.role: Math Worksheet PDF orchestrator. Plumbs include_challenge through.

flask_app/services/math_worksheet/render.role: Math Worksheet PDF renderer. When challenge is on, draws separate 'Answer Key - Challenge Section' page.

flask_app/services/spelling_worksheet/bu.role: Spelling Worksheet builder. Header says: no OpenAI, no chat_json, no Tavily. Uses _TOPIC_BANKS and grade banks.

flask_app/services/packaging.py.role: Export packaging. Contains the dedicated word_search, crossword, math_worksheet, spelling_worksheet, and coloring_book branches. Each uses the stored pdf_bytes directly and enforces no-fallback, no-ebook-files, ZIP-PDF-matches-direct-PDF QA.

flask_app/services/product.py.role: Dispatch + per-product PDF payload builders. Math Worksheet branch plumbs include_challenge through to pdf_builder.

flask_app/static/js/app.js.refresh_note: app.js md5 refreshed after approved Build Product auto-fire fix. sendToBuilder()'s ebook branch now auto-fires runEbook() so the user does not have to click Generate Ebook a second time. Locked puzzle/worksheet generator behavior was not changed.
flask_app/static/js/app.js.role: Factory UI. Math Worksheet card has include_challenge select (default No). Also handles Product Planning -> Product Builder handoff via resolveFactoryTypeFromPlan + hiddenReasonFor. Adds (1) wasWorkflow auto-download in runProduct, (2) scrollNextStepsPanelIntoView helper, (3) preview-card Download PDF button, (4) sendToBuilder ebook branch auto-fires runEbook. No generator behavior change.

flask_app/app.py.role: Route layer. The hidden-product guard at /generate-product (marketing_kit, cover_design, flip_book, planner -> 400) was added in the public menu cleanup lock and is unaffected by this lock.

word_search.word_source: Custom word list (18 curated computer parts)

crossword.word_source: Custom word list (18 curated office supplies)

qa_rules.byte_identical_artifacts: Direct download PDF == ZIP-inside PDF (md5 match) for every product.
qa_rules.no_openai_in_normal_path: Math worksheet: chat_json import removed from builder.py. Word search / crossword: custom_words path used. Spelling worksheet: local _TOPIC_BANKS path used.
qa_rules.no_fallback_export: The literal string 'FALLBACK EXPORT' must not appear in any downloaded PDF. packaging.py raises ValueError if it does.
qa_rules.saved_projects_filter: Test projects must be flagged system_test=true and temporary=true so the isUserSavedProject JS filter hides them. 0 test projects may leak into the user-visible list.

regression_test.name: puzzle_generators_v1_regression_test
manual_steps: 1. Compute md5 of every file under flask_app/services/{word_search,crossword,math_worksheet,spelling_worksheet}/ and confirm each matches the source_files section above.
2. Compute md5 of flask_app/services/packaging.py and confirm == 79F51290671EB9DCA0AA26940963E2A7.
3. Compute md5 of flask_app/services/product.py and confirm == 06DA649DB3A46AD2C615722B385EAC6C.
4. Compute md5 of flask_app/static/js/app.js and confirm == f59629484fb08e3a563a098ce8686da0.

5. POST /generate-product with product_type=word_search, theme='Computer Parts', custom_words=<18 curated words>, output_format='Single Puzzle', include_answer_key='Yes'. Expect HTTP 200, ~5,037 B PDF, 2 pages.

6. POST /generate-product with product_type=crossword, theme='Office Supplies', custom_words=<18 curated words>, output_format='Single Puzzle', include_answer_key='Yes'. Expect HTTP 200, ~5,490 B PDF, 2 pages.

7. POST /generate-product with product_type=math_worksheet, grade='3', math_topic='Mixed Arithmetic', problems='20', include_answer_key='Yes', include_challenge='No'. Expect HTTP 200, ~3,806 B PDF, 2 pages, no challenge problem.
8. POST /generate-product with product_type=math_worksheet, include_challenge='Yes'. Expect HTTP 200, ~5,610 B PDF, 4 pages, challenge answers present in the answer key.

9. POST /generate-product with product_type=spelling_worksheet, theme='Farm Animals', grade='3', word_count='10', activity_type='Word List', include_answer_key='Yes'. Expect HTTP 200, ~4,005 B PDF, 3 pages.
10. For each test, save the project (system_test=true, temporary=true), POST /export-product, then download the PDF + ZIP. Verify direct PDF md5 == ZIP-inside PDF md5.
11. Verify the literal string 'FALLBACK EXPORT' does not appear in any of the 4 downloaded PDFs.

12. Verify none of the 4 ZIPs contain ebook.html, ebook.txt, or ebook.pdf (math_worksheet + spelling_worksheet branches enforce this; word_search + crossword branches historically included ebook.html / ebook.txt as legacy support files - those are allowed for those two products but not for math_worksheet or spelling_worksheet).
13. Verify 0 test projects leaked into /projects user-visible list.
